summary: Strong test suite with excellent coverage of manifest parsing, compliance checking, CLI, and workflow structure. Comprehensive use of mocking and fixtures, well-organized by module. Notable gap: loadLicenseConfig (src/config.ts) lacks direct unit tests (only indirectly tested via CLI). Edge cases like very large dependency lists, empty license strings, and scoped npm packages not covered. Sophisticated act-based integration harness ensures end-to-end pipeline validation. Test design is clean with good helpers (mockLookup, writeTemp) and fixture isolation. Would catch most regressions but could benefit from direct config testing and broader edge case coverage.
